text: TVI is the flagship generalist television channel of Portuguese media group Grupo Media Capital, SGPS, S.A.: Media Capital's own website describes TVI on its 'Televisão' business page.
short: TVI is part of the Media Capital group.

source.name: Media Capital: Televisão (group business page for TVI)
source.quote: A TVI é o canal generalista que revolucionou a televisão portuguesa no início do século XXI.
source.note: Page undated; the 'Televisão' business area of mediacapital.pt. Translation: 'TVI is the generalist channel that revolutionised Portuguese television in the early 21st century.'
